title: This Shark Can Stay Pregnant for 3.5 Years
subject: frilled shark

scenes.text: One shark stays pregnant longer than any other animal with a backbone.
It's the frilled shark, a deep-sea animal that looks more like an eel.
Its mouth holds about three hundred needle-sharp teeth, arranged in roughly twenty-five rows.
It curves its body like a snake and strikes, swallowing prey more than half its own size.
And the pregnancy? Researchers estimate at least three and a half years, the longest known for any vertebrate.
A litter is only two to fifteen pups. Three and a half years of waiting for that.

description:
One shark can be pregnant for 3.5 years.
The frilled shark has about 300 teeth in roughly 25 rows, and researchers estimate a gestation of at least three and a half years, the longest known for any vertebrate.
Would you wait 3.5 years for anything? Comment below.
first_comment: A shark pregnancy longer than most presidential terms. What other animal do you want us to cover?
